runners.comment: Consistent over about 2m until fading over 2m5f last time; firmly in calculations
runners.name: Doyen Du Bar
runners.spotlight: Three wins last season (2m, various ground) and ran well to be placed towards the end of last year on first two starts for this yard; faded when upped to 2m5f last month and firmly in calculations now back down in trip.

runners.breeder: S A S I E I & Percy Holding Aps
runners.comment: Runner-up on three of his four starts this season and holds leading claims
runners.name: Torneo
runners.spotlight: Two wins during last season's novice chase campaign (2m, soft/good) and runner-up on three of his four starts this season, most recently going close at Windsor (2m, soft) behind a progressive winner; climbing the weights in defeat but leading claims today nevertheless.

runners.comment: Things yet to click this term but in the mix on last season's promise; makes stable debut
runners.name: Hombre De Guerra
runners.spotlight: Made fine start to chasing career last term, winning twice at Ayr (2m, soft); won on good to soft over hurdles; faced tough task on reappearance in November but well beaten in C&D handicap (soft) subsequently on final run for Nick Alexander; can be in the mix on stable debut if rediscovering last season's promise; remains in same ownership.

runners.comment: 12yo who has been in top form this season, following an absence, and could be thereabouts
runners.name: Bythesametoken
runners.spotlight: 12yo who has returned to his best this season, defying an absence to win at Listowel (2m1f, yielding to soft) in September before solid third at Haydock (2m4f, soft) a fortnight ago; the drop back in trip may well be a positive and he could be thereabouts.

runners.comment: Went close in warm little race at Musselburgh four weeks ago and he's respected
runners.name: Aeros Luck
runners.spotlight: Hurdle/chase winner for Gavin Cromwell who has improved with each of his four runs for this yard, most recently close second of five at Musselburgh (2m, good to soft); that looked a warm little race and he's respected.

runners.comment: Promising signs at Musselburgh on last two starts and might benefit from this shorter trip
runners.name: Bleu dEnfer
runners.spotlight: Won at Carlisle (2m4f, good) last April on final run for Stuart Crawford and signs of promise at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft) on last two starts, running well for a long way most recently when out of the handicap; runs off proper mark today and the drop back in trip might also be a positive.

runners.breeder: Scea Haras Des Evees & Mr Daniel Cherdo
runners.comment: Made all at Musselburgh on New Year's Day and remains well handicapped on past exploits
runners.name: Breizh River
runners.spotlight: Changed stables in autumn and has worked his way back into form, making all at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft) on New Year's Day in a first-time tongue-tie; back up 4lb he remains well handicapped on his past exploits, including a C&D win in October 2024; on the shortlist.

runners.comment: 3-time course winner; hopes pinned on return to Kelso and/or the visor sparking revival
runners.name: Chapel Green
runners.spotlight: Three-time course winner, the latest in September (2m5f, good); the return to Kelso could help, as might the first-time visor (replacing cheekpieces) but he's been disappointing at Newcastle and Musselburgh on his last two starts, and has shown good form there in the past.

runners.comment: Third in Old Roan at Aintree but poor efforts since and concedes weight all round
runners.name: Minella Drama
runners.spotlight: Smart on his day and ran creditably when third in the Old Roan at Aintree (2m4f, good to soft) in October, a race he'd won in 2024; however, two runs since have been poor and he has to concede weight all round.

runners.comment: Ex-Irish 12yo; last seen finishing sixth in 2024 Grand National; bit to prove after layoff
runners.name: Aint That A Shame
runners.spotlight: 12yo who had his finest hour when winning the Thyestes Chase at Gowran Park (3m1f, heavy) in January 2024, and he was far from disgraced when sixth in that year's Grand National; absent since, however, and changed hands for £40,000 in October 2025; bit to prove after a long absence; would probably benefit from plenty of rain.

runners.comment: Tremendous campaigner; clearcut winner at Windsor last time; very much the one to beat
runners.name: Protektorat
runners.owner: Sir A Ferguson G Mason L Hales The Late J Hales
runners.spotlight: Tremendous campaigner who has netted connections over £1m in prize-money; jumped right on occasions but was still firmly on top at finish in valuable conditions chase at Windsor (2m6f, soft) six weeks ago; usually races up with the pace; the clear pick on form and very much the one to beat.

runners.comment: Smart chaser in prime but well below par since December 2023; difficult to recommend
runners.name: Stolen Silver
runners.spotlight: Smart chaser in his prime but lightly raced and well below par since December 2023; perhaps another change of stable will revive his fortunes but he's difficult to recommend.

runners.comment: Made it 2-2 over hurdles in ready fashion at Newcastle; form reads well; leading claims
runners.name: Le Beau Madrik
runners.spotlight: Two-time bumper runner-up who won on hurdle debut at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) in November and followed up there (2m4f, soft) last month, readily beating solid yardsticks; leading claims despite 3lb penalty.

runners.comment: Won on h'dle debut here and has kept running well; needs something extra but not ruled out
runners.name: Caballo De Guerra
runners.owner: A H B Hodge & Mrs H Cheape
runners.spotlight: Won on hurdle debut here (2m, good) in October and has continued to run well, most recently fourth on handicap debut at Haydock (1m7f, good to soft) last month; needs something extra today but his stable won this last year and is having a much better February than January; not ruled out.

runners.comment: 1l behind Le Beau Madrik in November and easy win last time; yard won this in 2017 & 2020
runners.name: Gaelic Rover
runners.spotlight: 1l second to Le Beau Madrik at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) in November on second hurdle start and easily justified 30-100 odds there (2m1f, good to soft) last month; open to further improvement for stable that won this in 2017 and 2020; not discounted.

runners.comment: 2-3 over hurdles, the sole defeat coming behind classy type; could have more left in tank
runners.name: Kosac dOudairies
runners.spotlight: Point/bumper winner who made it 2-3 over hurdles with win at Catterick (2m3f, good to soft); others have achieved more but sole defeat in this sphere came behind a classy type; could have more left in the tank.

runners.comment: Fourth in Grade 1 Challow at Newbury in December and respected now back down in grade
runners.name: Montemares
runners.spotlight: Won in good style over hurdles on his first two starts (2m3f/2m4f, good/good to soft) before fourth of six in Grade 1 Challow at Newbury (2m4f, good) in December, albeit no match for the first three; the drop in grade is a plus, as might be the shorter trip; respected.

runners.comment: Won at Musselburgh then second to Kosac d'Oudairies; down the pecking order on form
runners.name: Red Oak
runners.spotlight: Won four-runner maiden at Musselburgh (2m4f, soft) in December on second hurdle start and solid second to Kosac d'Oudairies at Catterick (2m3f, good to soft) last time; however, he's down today's pecking order on form.

runners.comment: Two easy novice wins at Wetherby with Grade 1 defeat in between; leading form contender
runners.name: Starmount
runners.spotlight: 3m point winner who has twice easily made all in novice hurdles at Wetherby (2m, soft), with a 20l fourth of six in the Grade 1 Formby Novices' Hurdle at Aintree (2m1f, good to soft) in between; he's a leading form contender today for a trainer who won this in 2024.

runners.comment: Pulled up in Grade 2 last time but Grade 2 runner-up previously and could bounce back
runners.name: The Blue Room
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in Grade 2 at Cheltenham (2m4f, soft) last month but made early mistake and he's a lot better than that, as evidenced by his maiden win at Chepstow (2m, good to soft) and his 5l second in a Grade 2 at Sandown (2m4f, soft); no surprise if he bounces back with a big performance.

runners.comment: Has run with credit in defeat in Graded races on last three starts; might not be far away
runners.name: The Last Cloud
runners.owner: B Hague Mrs W Duffus & Partner
runners.spotlight: Won three in a row at Perth last May-September (2m, good; two of them handicaps) and has run with credit in defeat in Graded races on last three starts, the first two over 2m/2m1f (good to soft) and the latest at 3m (soft); he might not be far away.

runners.comment: Placed in maiden hurdles on last three starts but looks up against it today
runners.name: West Hill Verde
runners.spotlight: Placed in maiden hurdles on last three starts (2m-2m5f, soft), most recently runner-up at Doncaster; however, looks up against it today.

runners.comment: Fourth in Grade 2 Triumph Trial at Cheltenham and could benefit from today's extra yardage
runners.name: Lord Byron
runners.spotlight: Ex-Ballydoyle 4yo who built on his hurdle debut second at Exeter (2m, heavy) in December when 4l fourth in Grade 2 Triumph Trial at Cheltenham (2m1f, soft) last month; shaped last time as though he could benefit from today's extra yardage and he's a possible player in first-time cheekpieces.

14:55.race_name: bet365 Morebattle Hurdle (A Handicap Hurdle) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Fifth of 17 at Leopardstown last time and that form has received a couple of firm boosts
runners.name: Laafi
runners.spotlight: Very useful on the Flat; lightly raced over hurdles and bounced back from heavy defeat in the Greatwood with 11l fifth of 17 in competitive handicap at Leopardstown (2m, yielding) in December; that latest form has received a couple of firm boosts and this Irish challenger has each-way claims.

runners.comment: Haydock last time was step back in right direction & he's won the last 2 runnings of this
runners.name: Cracking Rhapsody
runners.owner: J D Wright & Mrs S Wright
runners.spotlight: Not at his best this season but Haydock last month was a step back in the right direction, after a wind op; has won here four times, including the last two runnings of this race (good to soft), and he's 1lb lower than when winning the Scottish Champion Hurdle last April; major player.

runners.comment: Won Grade 2 novice hurdle on this card last year; not ruled out after a stint over fences
runners.name: Jet To Vegas
runners.spotlight: Finished held over fences at Musselburgh on New Year's Day on his handicap debut, but didn't run badly and has had wind surgery since; won the Grade 2 Premier Novices' Hurdle on this cards 12 months ago (2m2f, good to soft) and is not ruled out now back in this sphere.

runners.comment: Went close in Grade 2 Elite Hurdle in November and has potential off opening mark
runners.name: Hamlets Night
runners.spotlight: Two novice hurdle wins in September (2m, good) and pushed higher-rated rivals close on next two starts (2m/1m7f, good), in the Grade 2 Elite Hurdle on the second occasion; AW win since; effective on slow ground on the Flat in France in 2024; has potential off this mark on handicap hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Returned to form for Haydock win; this is tougher but he's unexposed under hold-up tactics
runners.name: Serious Challenge
runners.spotlight: Made it four wins from his eight starts over hurdles (various ground) when returning to form to score at Haydock (1m7f, good) two months ago, when ridden more patiently; 5lb higher in a better race today and needs a career-best but he's unexposed under hold-up tactics and is not written off.

runners.comment: Did it nicely in competitive h'cap at Windsor latest; this 5yo could continue to progress
runners.name: Hot Fuss
runners.spotlight: 5yo who races prominently and has been progressive this season in some competitive handicaps, finishing second at Ascot (1m7f, good to soft) in December and winning at Windsor (2m, soft) last month; up 5lb for last time but he did it nicely and could continue to improve; respected.

runners.comment: Novice who has shown considerable promise and could have a part to play on handicap debut
runners.name: Captain Hugo
runners.spotlight: Two wins (2m/1m7f, good to soft/good) from his first three hurdle starts and he was bang there when falling three out in a novice at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) four weeks ago; this unexposed 6yo may well have more to offer and could have a part to play on his handicap debut.

runners.comment: 6th to Hot Fuss at Windsor but 3lb drop, rider's claim and return to Kelso could all help
runners.name: Spectacularsunrise
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo who made it two wins in a row (good/soft) when scoring on handicap debut over C&D in December; only sixth of 14 behind Hot Fuss at Windsor (2m, soft) last month but a 3lb drop, Toby McCain-Mitchell's 5lb claim and the return to Kelso could all be positives; possibilities.

runners.comment: Unraced at the trip and this may be too competitive, but he's in good form and likes Kelso
runners.name: Serious Operator
runners.spotlight: Won at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) in November and second to progressive winner at Aintree (2m4f, good to soft) in December; unraced over a trip this short and there's a suspicion this 9yo will be vulnerable in a race this competitive, but he's 2-3 at Kelso and is not ruled out each-way.

runners.comment: Third at Musselburgh last time; could be capable of better but such improvement necessary
runners.name: Wise Eagle
runners.spotlight: Runner-up here (2m, soft) last February and back on song when third at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) four weeks ago; he's lightly raced over hurdles and is on an attractive mark judged on his very useful Flat form, but he needs to raise his game if he's to take this.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 6yo who is 2-2 here but over 2m5f/2m6f; a career-best is needed
runners.name: Lucky Manifest
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-2 here on stable debut in October (2m6f, good) and close second of 18 at Cheltenham (2m5f, soft) next time; hasn't run badly on either starts since and this lightly raced 6yo could benefit from the return to Kelso, but a career-best is needed and the drop to 2m isn't an obvious plus.

runners.comment: C&D maiden winner who has dropped down the weights in this sphere; not ruled out each-way
runners.name: Dedicated Hero
runners.spotlight: Won C&D maiden hurdle and substandard Haydock Grade 2 in winter 2024-25; mixed form since but he was a good second on his chase debut at Ayr last month; first-fence unseat next time (hampered); he's dropped down the weights over hurdles and is not ruled out each-way in first-time cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Consistent and improvement is possible on handicap debut, but necessary in a hot race
runners.name: Bespoke Tailor
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner has finished in the first three in his four maiden/novice hurdles (1m7f-2m1f, good to soft/soft); wears first-time tongue-tie on handicap debut and improvement is possible, but necessary in this hot race.

runners.comment: Encouraging fourth over C&D recently but he's now in a higher grade than he's used to
runners.name: Berties Ballet
runners.spotlight: On a handy mark on last winter's form and he was an encouraging fourth of nine over C&D recently on his second start back from a long absence; however, this is a higher grade than he's used to; could be vulnerable.

runners.comment: Won in good style on handicap debut at Musselburgh but merely 6th there on both runs since
runners.name: City Of Diamonds
runners.spotlight: Won in good style on handicap debut at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) in November but merely sixth there on next two starts (1m7f, good to soft) and the first-time tongue-tie needs to prompt a bigger performance.

runners.comment: Speedy Kempton didn't appear to play to his strengths on handicap debut; in top hands
runners.name: Quaviste
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who was runner-up in a novice hurdle at Market Rasen (2m, good to soft) in December and not beaten far when fifth of eight on handicap debut at Kempton (2m, good) last month, when the speedy track didn't appear to play to his strengths; in top hands and could take a step forward today.

runners.comment: This is hotter than he's used to but he has excellent record at Kelso when conditions suit
runners.name: Heart Above
runners.spotlight: Has plied his trade in lower grades and he needs to prove his current mark isn't beyond him; however, he has an excellent record at Kelso when the ground is good or good to soft, with his form-figures in such circumstances reading 2322121; interesting contender.

runners.comment: Good second at Doncaster after layoff but will need a career best to defy top weight
runners.name: Fingals Hill
runners.spotlight: In fine form last spring and summer, and returned from seven months off with a good 2l second of four at Doncaster (2m3f, soft) in January; always gives his all but he'll need a career best to defy top weight.

runners.comment: Six straight wins in 2024 but will need to be firing on all cylinders after 441 days off
runners.name: Skyjack Hijack
runners.spotlight: On a roll in the second half of 2024, rattling off six straight wins (2m5f-3m1f) before coming unstuck when favourite for Grade 2 novice at Cheltenham; it's possible he's still to reach his ceiling but he'll need to be firing on all cylinders after 441 days off.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 5yo; asserted late on at Plumpton; 4lb higher mark is not insurmountable
runners.name: Good To Be Alive
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo; notched a first win for current yard when asserting late on at Plumpton (2m4f, soft) five weeks ago; still unexposed and a 4lb higher mark does not look insurmountable.

runners.comment: Won here just after Christmas; possible excuse last time but remains on a career-high mark
runners.name: Both Barrels
runners.spotlight: Goes well here and won over the extended 2m6f (good to soft) just after Christmas; ridden less prominently when only sixth of ten at Haydock next time; may bounce back, although he remains on a career-high mark.

runners.comment: Twice went close at start of season and 3m possibly stretched him last time; big player
runners.name: Florida Dreams
runners.spotlight: Has won only one of his 13 handicaps but twice went very close at the start of the season and 3m possibly stretched his stamina at Musselburgh last time; back to a more suitable trip here and unlikely to be far away.

runners.comment: Holding his form well; now up in distance, which may well suit; solid claims
runners.name: Smart Decision
runners.spotlight: Won five of his first six completed starts over hurdles (1m7f-2m2f) and has run well in defeat on his last two; now up in distance, which may well suit him, and he handles any ground; solid claims.

runners.comment: Hard to fancy on recent form but won this 12 months ago; return here could spark a revival
runners.name: Bold Light
runners.spotlight: Hard to fancy on this season's form (last two runs over fences) but he's now 3lb lower than when winning this race 12 months ago (good to soft); unbeaten in two runs at Kelso and returning here could spark a revival.

runners.comment: Running creditably at present but has stamina to prove over this much longer trip
runners.name: Frontier Prince
runners.spotlight: Holding his form pretty well, creditable third of ten at Kempton (2m, good to soft) four weeks ago, but he will need something extra off just 1lb lower and has stamina to prove over this much longer trip.

16:00.race_name: bet365 Juvenile Hurdle (Go North Night Nurse Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Won sole French run; tailed off on British debut but could be different proposition today
runners.name: Vivre Le Reve
runners.owner: Burns P & M Morrall Stokes & Wicks
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles in November on sole start in France (2m1f, heavy) and bought for £100,000 seven days later; tailed off at 15-8 on British debut at Wetherby (2m, soft) last month but he's in good hands and it will be no surprise if he's an entirely different proposition today.

runners.comment: Made all at Catterick on third hurdle start; stable has won last two runnings of this race
runners.name: Belaya River
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden on the Flat but showed hints of promise on first two hurdle starts before making all at Catterick (1m7f, soft) last month; could continue to improve and trainer has won the last two runnings of this race.

runners.comment: 33-1 win from Keyboard on hurdle debut at Musselburgh; likely player if backing that up
runners.name: Bruce Banner
runners.spotlight: Two-time Flat winner at an ordinary level and he won at 33-1 on hurdle debut at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) in November, beating Keyboard by just over 2l; likely player under a penalty if backing up that effort.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten on both hurdle starts and a big step forward is needed
runners.name: Captain Connor
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability when third at Huntingdon (2m, good to soft) in November in his sole bumper but soundly beaten subsequently on his two hurdle starts (1m7f/2m, good to soft/soft); big step forward needed.

runners.comment: Runner-up on all 3 hurdle starts; needs to get the job done but has leading form claims
runners.name: Keyboard
runners.spotlight: Hung badly right at Musselburgh a fortnight ago in first-time cheekpieces (retained) and needs to prove he can get the job done; however, he's now finished second on all three hurdle starts and holds leading form claims.

runners.comment: Failed to settle when always behind at 66-1 on recent hurdle debut at Musselburgh
runners.name: Storm The Dug
runners.spotlight: Made the frame over 7f/1m on the Flat; with a respected stable but he failed to settle when always behind at 66-1 on recent hurdle debut at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) and a transformation is needed today.

runners.comment: Displayed promise on the Flat in Ireland and brings potential to this hurdle/stable debut
runners.name: Word For Word
runners.spotlight: Displayed promise when fourth of eight at Killarney (1m3f, yielding to soft) last July on the second of his three Flat starts for John Murphy; brings potential to this first hurdle/stable start and it will be no surprise to see a good run, especially if strong in the betting; a hood goes on.

16:35.race_name: bet365 Mares' Novices' Hurdle (Herring Queen Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Work to do with A Path To Ronda but a case can be made for her being best of the rest
runners.name: Bittalemon
runners.spotlight: Two novice wins at Cartmel (2m1f, good to soft/good) last summer; faded into seventh of nine in Listed race at Haydock (2m3f, good to soft) in December when back from a break; work to do with A Path To Ronda on that form but a case can be made for her being best of the rest now back down in trip.

runners.comment: Third in Listed/Grade 2 races on last two starts and this is an excellent opportunity
runners.name: A Path To Ronda
runners.spotlight: Won on hurdle debut at Stratford (2m6f, good to soft) in October and third in Listed/Grade 2 races on last two starts (2m3f, good to soft/heavy); drops back in trip today but it's an excellent opportunity for her to return to winning ways.

runners.comment: Hasn't really kicked on since 125-1 win in October but still an each-way player today
runners.name: Just An Artist
runners.spotlight: 125-1 win in maiden hurdle at Perth (2m, soft) in October; hasn't really kicked on since but ran okay when third at Carlisle (2m3f, good to soft) last time and she's an each-way player today.

runners.comment: Pulled up/well beaten at triple-figure odds on her two hurdle starts and hard to fancy
runners.name: Am I Bovvered
runners.spotlight: Pulled up/well beaten at triple-figure odds on her two hurdle starts (2m/2m3f, soft/good to soft) and she's hard to fancy.

runners.comment: Down the field in sole bumper and likewise when 100-1 on hurdle debut, also at Carlisle
runners.name: Bollin Skittle
runners.spotlight: Down the field in sole bumper (2m1f, soft) and likewise when 100-1 for this month's hurdle debut, also at Carlisle (2m3f, good to soft).

runners.comment: Took a step forward at Musselburgh but will probably be of greater interest in handicaps
runners.name: Changemyluck
runners.spotlight: Took a step forward when third of six at 80-1 at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft) a fortnight ago on second hurdle start; however, she was still soundly beaten and will probably be of greater interest in handicaps.

runners.comment: Form is significantly inferior to that of A Path To Ronda but certainly a place contender
runners.name: Hunters Spring
runners.spotlight: Good-ground bumper winner who has run okay when fourth on first two hurdle starts (2m/2m1f, soft/good to soft); her form is significantly inferior to that of A Path To Ronda but she's certainly a place contender.

runners.comment: Bumper winner; shaped as though she needed last month's hurdle debut, after long absence
runners.name: Sagonige
runners.spotlight: Having attracted market support she was tailed off on hurdle debut at Ayr (2m, soft) last month, following a long absence; needs to prove how much ability she retains but this bumper winner failed to settle last time and shaped as though she needed the run; no surprise to see a good performance.

17:10.race_name: bet365 Cyril Alexander Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Started well over fences for new yard; below par at Cheltenham latest but this is easier
runners.name: Push The Button
runners.owner: The 8 Amigos Readers & Wiggy N Skinner
runners.spotlight: Made a good start over fences for new connections, winning at Carlisle (2m, good) in October and finishing second in a Grade 2 novice at Ascot (2m3f, soft); let down by his jumping in competitive handicap at Cheltenham last time but he's in shallower waters here and should be thereabouts.

runners.comment: Progressive over hurdles; gifted first race over fences; stamina to prove but unexposed
runners.name: Old Gregorian
runners.spotlight: Progressive hurdler last term, finishing third in the Morebattle (2m, good to soft) on this card; gifted his first race over fences at Wetherby (2m3f, good) when sole rival unseated rider; stamina to prove over this longer trip but he's still unexposed and represents last year's winning yard.

runners.comment: Shaped well twice here towards end of 2025 and this drop in distance should suit
runners.name: Al Kalila
runners.spotlight: Ayr maiden hurdle winner (2m4f; made much of running) last winter; shaped well over the extended 2m7f here on his first two starts this season and he wasn't disgraced over 3m at Down Royal last time; this drop in distance should suit him and he could be ready to strike.

runners.comment: Won hurdle at Perth last April but hasn't cut much ice since; bit to prove in cheekpieces
runners.name: Scarlet Jet
runners.spotlight: Comfortably won maiden hurdle at Perth (2m4f, good to soft) last April but hasn't cut much ice since, including on chasing debut at Carlisle earlier this month; fair bit to prove from out of the weights on handicap debut and needs first-time cheekpieces to have a positive effect.

13:35.race_name: Simple Boost Tokens Now At BetVictor Conditional Jockeys' Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Returns to a suitable level on handicap debut; sole runner on the card for Scottish yard
runners.name: Smoke Trail
runners.spotlight: Point/hurdle winner; has faced tougher assignments the last twice (additionally, did too much up front latest) and this looks more suitable on handicap debut; sole runner on the card for his Scottish yard.

runners.comment: Record of 2-3 for new stable; scored in a canter at Fontwell last Sunday; respected
runners.name: Queenie St Clair
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish mare who is 2-3 for new stable, most recently scoring in a canter at Fontwell (2m1f, heavy) last Sunday; open to further progress and looks well in under a 7lb penalty; commands respect.

runners.comment: Chance partly depends on what the weather does; gained his hurdle wins on good ground
runners.name: Ocean Conquest
runners.spotlight: Failed to convince over 3m at Newbury last time; likely to benefit from drop back in trip but chance partly depends on what the weather does; has gained his hurdle wins (2m/2m5f) on good ground.

runners.comment: May show progress returned to 2m in this third British attempt
runners.name: Locquirec
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 5yo who has shown promise and is still lightly raced; dropped away over 2m4f on soft ground last time (handicap debut); may show progress returned to 2m in this third British attempt.

runners.comment: May build on Plumpton success and display further improvement; one to consider
runners.name: Eddie My Eagle
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo who showed a consistent level of promise prior to opening his account in Plumpton novice hurdle (2m, soft) last time; may build on that success and display further improvement; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Best to forgive latest effort; may be open to progress now handicapping
runners.name: Sutherland
runners.spotlight: Has switched to hurdles this term for new yard, running well at Southwell (2m) on penultimate start; heavy ground provides an excuse for latest effort; may be open to progress now handicapping.

runners.comment: Handicap debutant who looks well treated on best performances; interesting contender
runners.name: Unjeu Royal
runners.spotlight: Handicap debutant who looks well treated on the form of his bumper success and his best hurdles effort (second to fairly useful sort); best to forgive latest run (bled from nose); interesting contender.

runners.comment: Juvenile hurdler who may settle better and show additional progress with hood now fitted
runners.name: Treasure Planet
runners.spotlight: Juvenile hurdler who has proved a free-going sort but may settle better and find additional progress with hood now fitted; scored by a wide margin at Ludlow (2m, good) on penultimate start; possibilities.

14:10.race_name: BetVictor Favourite Things, Bet Boosts Handicap Hurdle (Challenger Two Mile Hurdle Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Pulled up in his latest chase; last spring's peak hurdles form would put him in the mix
runners.name: The Four Sixes
runners.spotlight: Both his chase wins this term were gained at very skinny odds in tiny-field novice events; pulled up in his latest chase 15 days ago but last spring's peak hurdles form would put him in the mix.

runners.comment: Won under Megan Fox at Haydock before running well in Grade 2 at Cheltenham; e-w player
runners.name: Brentford Hope
runners.spotlight: Won by a neck at Haydock (2m, good to soft) last month under Megan Fox and is 4lb higher today; performed as well as could be expected in the face of a stiff task when third of four in Grade 2 at Cheltenham a week later and has each-way claims on this return to handicap company.

runners.comment: Not entirely dismissed given that this test looks more suitable than recent British debut
runners.name: Last Kingdom
runners.spotlight: Came good for Willie Mullins last spring and went in again at Listowel in September; looked a non-stayer at 2m4f on final Irish start and, although he didn't show much when 50-1 confronted with 2m5f on heavy on British debut, he's not entirely dismissed given that this test looks more suitable.

runners.comment: 5-10 over hurdles, including with wins under Freddie Keighley on two of last three outings
runners.name: Brave Knight
runners.spotlight: 5-10 over hurdles, including with wins under Freddie Keighley at Fontwell (2m1f) and Taunton (2m3f) on two of his last three outings; that demands respect even though he's been raised another 5lb and has more to prove if the ground is worse than good to soft.

runners.breeder: S C E A Le Haras DHaspel
runners.comment: Unexposed handicap debutant, including because he played up before latest intended start
runners.name: Doctor Blue
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who went close in Cheltenham Grade 2 on hurdle debut before getting off the mark at Ascot (1m7f, good) in November; found to have bled when well held next time and played up at the start (deemed a non-runner) at Exeter eight days ago; wore tongue-tie on those last three appearances and cheekpieces at Exeter, but has neither today; unexposed handicap debutant.

runners.comment: Good third at Cheltenham; claimer ridden when disappointing at Windsor six weeks ago
runners.name: Melon
runners.spotlight: 2-4 in juvenile hurdles (including a win on soft) and reappeared with a good third of 11 in handicap at Cheltenham (2m1f, good to soft) in December; claimer ridden when disappointing at Windsor six weeks ago but could bounce back.

runners.comment: Two good 2nds before tailing off over 2m3f at Ascot; back down in trip and from wind op
runners.name: Marche dAligre
runners.owner: Billam Roe Swindell Wilson & The Molds
runners.spotlight: 1-8 over hurdles, with the win on first attempt; good second at Wetherby and Sandown (both 2m on soft) to start this season, before tailing off over 2m3f at Ascot on soft six weeks ago; back down in trip and has now had wind surgery; needs to resume his progress.

runners.comment: C&D novice win (soft) last February; stable form and return to 2m boost interest in him
runners.name: Rubber Ball
runners.spotlight: Has not been at his best this season but trying 2m4f (twice; showed plenty on first occasion) and 3m (pulled up on heavy last time) on his last three outings may have been against him; career peak was a C&D novice win (soft) last February and his stable form, as well as the drop back in trip, makes him of renewed interest.

14:40.race_name: BetVictor Now Non Runner No Bet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (For Jacky Upton Trophy) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Record of 5-7 (hurdles/fences) for current yard and 3-3 since ridden by Charlie Deutsch
runners.name: Rodney
runners.spotlight: Record 5-7 (hurdles/fences) for current yard and 3-3 since ridden by Charlie Deutsch; looked value for more than the winning margin at Ludlow (2m4f, soft) most recently; respected with further progress possible.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De La Croix Sonnet Et Al
runners.comment: Campaigned only at about 2m; doesn't shape as if he's crying out for this new trip
runners.name: Palacio
runners.spotlight: Campaigned only at about 2m; has failed to back up the form of his Chepstow reappearance win and, contrary to parts of his pedigree, doesn't shape as if he's crying out for this new trip.

runners.comment: Combination of 3m and soft surface perhaps contributed to latest defeat
runners.name: Noble Park
runners.spotlight: Commenced chase career with a couple of good-ground wins; below par in two starts since but the combination of 3m and soft surface perhaps contributed to latest defeat; drop back in trip looks a plus.

runners.comment: Ran respectably in traditionally strong novice handicap at Cheltenham last time
runners.name: Scorsese
runners.spotlight: Opened his chase account in Sedgefield event on Boxing Day (sole start under Harry Atkins); ran respectably in traditionally strong novice handicap at Cheltenham (2m4f, soft) since; in the mix.

runners.comment: Chase/seasonal debutant; gained sole hurdles win on this card last year
runners.name: Authentic Legacy
runners.spotlight: Chase debutant who badly lacks recent match practice (absent for 337 days) but is otherwise interesting, having gained his sole hurdles success on this card last year; market may offer further guidance.

runners.comment: Challenging the eventual winner when falling last time; may still have more to offer
runners.name: Mon Champion
runners.spotlight: Challenging the eventual winner when falling three out at Leicester last time when bidding for a 2m double; may still have more to offer for current stable and had form at up to 2m6f in France; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Consistent but still a maiden in the chase sphere; had wind surgery since last run
runners.name: Southoftheborder
runners.spotlight: Consistent for current yard but remains a maiden in the chase sphere; chance of winning depends on how well he responds to physical tweak (wind surgery since last run) combined with fitting of tongue-tie.

runners.comment: Lightly raced and may do better still; returns to the scene of his hurdles win
runners.name: King Califet
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo; soundly beaten in sole start this season (chase debut; had wind surgery since) but may do better still and can't be written off; returns to the scene of his hurdles win.

15:15.race_name: 1 Up, Job Done At BetVictor Veterans' Handicap Chase (Leg 2 Of The Stayers' Veterans' Chase Series)

runners.comment: Smart for Willie Mullins but has been absent for a year; market helpful
runners.name: Capodanno
runners.spotlight: Capable of smart form for Willie Mullins and landed the Cotswold Chase two years ago; however, badly lacks recent match practice having been absent since finishing third in the Bobbyjo last February; remains with same owner; market may offer further guidance.

runners.comment: Successful in similar event on penultimate start; ideally needs a sound surface
runners.name: Hang In There
runners.spotlight: Successful in similar event at Chepstow in October (penultimate start) and returns from another break with Rian Corcoran taking off a useful 7lb; however, chance largely depends on what the weather does (ideally needs a sound surface).

runners.comment: 14yo; won this race off 2lb higher last year; good chance if back on song
runners.name: Sam Brown
runners.spotlight: The oldest of these veterans, being a 14yo, and bare form this term leaves a question mark over whether he retains the useful ability that has been present for a long time; however, won this race off 2lb higher last year (soft) and has a good chance if back on song.

runners.comment: Form this season features a win in veterans' race; has good Newbury form; solid
runners.name: Eldorado Allen
runners.spotlight: Form over shorter this term features a reappearance success in veterans' race at Cheltenham (2m4f, soft; beat Mister Coffey); record at Newbury includes a success in 2m7f Grade 2 in 2022 and respectable effort in major 3m2f handicap in 2023; solid claims.

runners.breeder: S C E A Le Haras DHaspel
runners.comment: Has lots of useful form but is famously frustrating and still a maiden over fences
runners.name: Mister Coffey
runners.spotlight: Let down by his jumping when returned to the cross-country course at Cheltenham last time; has lots of useful form otherwise and ties in with Eldorado Allen on reappearance running; well capable of being involved but is famously frustrating and still a maiden over fences (0-18).

runners.comment: Interesting off current mark switched to a veterans' contest for the first time
runners.name: Our Power
runners.spotlight: Has good form in plenty of notable handicaps, including two wins in the 2022-23 campaign; far from solid on his results this season but looks interesting off his current mark switched to a veterans' contest for the first time; new headgear may contribute to a plausible resurgence.

runners.comment: Remains on last winning mark; fighting chance provided he's in good form
runners.name: Copperhead
runners.spotlight: Unseated rider three out, having still been prominent, at Sandown last time when bidding for a second success in the final of this series; remains on the last winning mark, so holds a fighting chance provided he's in good form and completes the course.

runners.breeder: S A R L Haras Du Bois Emery
runners.comment: Has shown consistent form this term, all in veterans' events; likely player
runners.name: Torn And Frayed
runners.spotlight: Has shown consistent form (3122) this term, all in veterans' events, the success at Aintree (3m1f, good); ran creditably, one place in front of Eldorado Allen, at Cheltenham (2m4f) last time; likely player, assuming he continues in the same vein.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 10yo; respected off an attractive mark switched to a veterans' race
runners.name: Brave Kingdom
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 10yo who posted a resurgent effort in small field at Taunton (2m7f) most recently; form at Newbury features a success over 2m7f in 2023 and placed effort in the Mandarin over 3m2f in 2024; respected off an attractive mark switched to a veterans' contest.

runners.comment: Ran well in the latest final of this series; possibilities if taking to cheekpieces
runners.name: Gabbys Cross
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 11yo who is on a long losing spell but brings notable recent form, having posted best effort for new yard when third in the latest final of this series (penultimate start); possibilities off current mark, provided he takes well to first-time cheekpieces.

15:45.race_name: BetVictor Greatwood Gold Cup Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Form this season features a C&D performance that suggests he's an ideal type for this race
runners.name: Twinjets
runners.spotlight: Front-running chaser who made a bad mistake and unseated rider mid-race when favourite for similar event at Cheltenham last time; successful in both completed starts this term, looking better than ever, including a C&D performance (good to soft; beat Heltenham by 10l) that suggests he's an ideal candidate for this prize; respected.

runners.comment: Literal reading of latest effort (in Grade 1; stable debut) suggests a 2lb rise is lenient
runners.name: Blow Your Wad
runners.spotlight: Grade 2 novice winner a couple of years ago for Tom Lacey; seemed to run well in the face of a stiff task in Grade 1 contest at Ascot (2m5f, good to soft) last time on debut for new yard; that bare form may not be reliable but a literal reading suggests a 2lb rise is lenient; interesting back at handicap level.

runners.breeder: Yvon Madiot Herve Tison & Pauline Tison
runners.comment: Readily justified favouritism at Kempton last time, taking chase record to 3-6; in the mix
runners.name: Issam
runners.spotlight: Seemed a non-stayer over 3m on penultimate start; readily justified favouritism at Kempton (2m4f, good to soft) latest, taking chase record to 3-6 and overall strike-rate to 9-25; largely progressive and a useful 3lb is claimed with Callum Pritchard back on board; one to consider.

runners.comment: Chase record of 1212221 includes a good effort in this race last year; rock-solid claims
runners.name: Vincenzo
runners.spotlight: Ran well in this race last year and similarly notable handicaps at Cheltenham in November/December; confirmed his reliability by justifying favouritism at Ascot (2m5f, soft) most recently, taking chase record to 1212221; rock-solid contender who again looks sure to be involved.

runners.comment: Record of 3-5 at Newbury features a success in this contest two years ago; not ruled out
runners.name: Heltenham
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late N W Lake
runners.spotlight: Record of 3-5 at Newbury features a success in this contest two years ago; proved no match for Twinjets in most recent course start and was a faller in last two handicap attempts (out of depth in Grade 1 since); however, holds a major chance off current mark provided he's in top form.

runners.comment: Raced mainly over shorter; failed to improve for the 2m4f trip last time; opposed
runners.name: Teddy Blue
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly over shorter; disappointing favourite when bidding for a 2m1f double at Ascot in November and failed to improve for the 2m4f trip, albeit not entirely disgraced, at Musselburgh since; others have less to prove at this distance.

runners.comment: Novice chaser who has performed creditably off current mark, albeit at a lower level
runners.name: Josh The Boss
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful novice chaser who scored easily at Doncaster in November and has performed creditably off current mark twice since, albeit failed to justify favouritism when sent up to Newcastle (2m4f) last time; goes into deeper waters at this level.

runners.comment: Gained his notable Cheltenham win from the front; not sure to get his own way
runners.name: Glengouly
runners.spotlight: Unable to dominate on New Year's Day when bidding for a notable Cheltenham double, failing to back up the form of his front-running success in December; again not sure to get his own way and will be more interesting when back in a scenario where he can dictate.

runners.comment: Has a solid record this season but the 10yo looks under some pressure in this field
runners.name: Triple Trade
runners.spotlight: Has a solid record (1313) over 2m/2m4f this season but gained the wins in Class 3 and finished 10l behind a couple of younger rivals, albeit not disgraced, in Class 1 at Cheltenham most recently; the 10yo looks under some pressure kept to this level.

runners.comment: Disappointing favourite last time but it's difficult to write off this low-mileage 8yo
runners.name: Pleasington
runners.spotlight: Has two pieces of encouraging form since switched to fences, including a Newbury effort (2m) that suggests he should be suited by 2m4f; disappointing favourite (looked beaten when falling) at Wetherby last time but it's difficult to write off this low-mileage 8yo, who represents last year's winning stable.

runners.comment: Novice chaser who may still have more to offer; could go well off bottom weight
runners.name: Koukeo
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite, albeit far from discredited, at Musselburgh last time when bidding to take his chase record (all over 2m) to 3-3; may still have more to offer and this return to further is worth a go (2m5f hurdles winner); steps up in class but receives weight all round; could go well.

16:23.race_name: Simple Racing Specials Daily At BetVictor Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Lumbered with top weight back down in class but is 1-1 at Newbury and could go well
runners.name: Goodwin
runners.spotlight: Front-runner whose record of 4-13 over hurdles includes two wins this term; dropped away in the Lanzarote last time; lumbered with top weight back down in grade but he's 1-1 at Newbury and could go well.

runners.comment: Promising sort who is two from two, namely wins in C&D novice race and Doncaster handicap
runners.name: Huffin An A Puffin
runners.spotlight: Promising sort who is two from two, namely wins in C&D novice hurdle in March 2024 (for Harry Derham) and Doncaster handicap (2m3f, soft) this month; open to any amount of further progress, assuming he doesn't bounce; respected.

runners.comment: Fairly useful juvenile hurdler last term; absent since midfield finish in the Fred Winter
runners.name: Teriferma
runners.spotlight: Showed a good strike-rate (3-6) and proved fairly useful as a juvenile hurdler last term but has been absent since midfield finish in the Fred Winter; market may offer further guidance.

runners.comment: Let down by her jumping last time but is still lightly raced and can't be written off
runners.name: Just A Rose
runners.owner: Mrs Jennifer Irish Kate & Andrew Brooks
runners.spotlight: Let down by her jumping in the Lanzarote last time, failing to build on reappearance effort; however, remains lightly raced and may yet confirm the promise of her Taunton win (rules debut) last term; not written off.

runners.breeder: Sas Elevage Du Haras De Bourgeauville
runners.comment: Both wins in Class 4; pair of duck eggs since the latest one; others preferred
runners.name: Yellow Star
runners.owner: Tim Lord Kc And G L Moore
runners.spotlight: Has gained both wins in Class 4, including for his standout performance this term; pair of duck eggs since, albeit the 2m7f trip perhaps contributed to latest defeat; others have stronger claims.

runners.comment: Handicap debutant who is particularly well treated on his strong bumper form; interesting
runners.name: Kilwaughter
runners.spotlight: Unraced on soft/heavy; handicap debutant who looks particularly well treated on his strong bumper form; has gradually found his feet since switched to hurdles and latest effort, namely solid second over 2m3f at Taunton, has received a couple of boosts; interesting contender.

runners.comment: Lightly raced and inconsistent since completing a hat-trick in 2023
runners.name: Bingoo
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and inconsistent since completing a hat-trick in 2023; last off five finishers at Hereford most recently, failing to back up reappearance effort; others preferred.

runners.breeder: Haras De La Haie Neuve Sas Regnier
runners.comment: Has taken his form to a new level since upped to about 2m4f; may have more to offer
runners.name: Lucky Bere
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent over hurdles; has taken his form to a new level since upped to about 2m4f, winning at Wincanton (soft) then going close at Hereford (heavy); may have more to offer at this distance; looks a solid one for the shortlist.

runners.comment: In-form mare; raced mostly at about 2m but this return to further is worth exploring
runners.name: Tour Ovalie
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly about 2m; record is 6-21, the most recent win at Ludlow in December; placed twice since, including at Newbury, and remains in form; gives the impression this return to further is worth exploring.

runners.comment: Hasn't won over hurdles since 2022; admittedly not disgraced in this race last year
runners.name: Fine Casting
runners.spotlight: Mixed results (1P4) since returned to chasing; runs off a lower hurdles mark but has a downside, being a 10yo who hasn't scored in this sphere since 2022; admittedly not disgraced in this race last year.

runners.breeder: Elms Bloodstock & Miss A Gibson Fleming
runners.comment: Hat-trick seeker; up in grade and goes back against males but is a progressive mare
runners.name: Analiese
runners.spotlight: Bids for a hat-trick, having made all in mares' contests over 2m4f at Uttoxeter (soft) and Aintree (good to soft) in December, taking record to 3-8; upped in grade and goes back against males but is a progressive contender.

16:58.race_name: OLBG Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: 2-2 in bumpers, including Listed event; open to further progress and high on the list
runners.name: Malina Road
runners.spotlight: Sister to the useful hurdler Yellow Car; made a winning debut under rules at Ludlow and showed plenty of improvement to follow up in Listed event at Market Rasen (good to soft), making smooth headway under a patient ride; open to further progress and high on the list despite having to concede weight all round.

runners.comment: Unbeaten in point and bumper, readily making all in latter; looks a useful prospect
runners.name: Princess Day
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten in Irish point and bumper at Chepstow, just pushed out after making running on second occasion (good to soft); yard had another bumper winner at Exeter last week and this one looks a useful prospect.

runners.comment: In frame all starts to date, 15l second at Huntingdon on latest; impossible to rule out
runners.name: Affric Kintail
runners.spotlight: In frame all starts to date, improving on form of rules debut when 15l second of ten at Huntingdon (soft ground; still looked green) five weeks ago; may progress further and impossible to rule out.

runners.comment: Easily won Irish point last spring; fascinating rules newcomer, well worth a market check
runners.name: Fairy Park
runners.spotlight: Easily won an Irish point last spring (good to yielding) and the well-held third has won one since; nicely bred (out of a half-sister to the top-class Bellshill) and a fascinating rules newcomer, well worth a market check.

runners.comment: Showed something to build on when fourth at Uttoxeter; has a bit to find on the figures
runners.name: Kayleigh
runners.spotlight: Showed something to build on when a staying-on fourth at Uttoxeter (good to soft; 16-1) almost a year ago; has since changed stables; should do better in due course but has a bit to find on the figures.

runners.comment: Shaped well on debut and next run best ignored; in good hands; remains capable of better
runners.name: Lady Boujee
runners.spotlight: Shaped promisingly when second at Market Rasen (good to soft) in December, and her next run at Huntingdon is best ignored as she was hampered and nearly lost her rider 4f out; in good hands and remains capable of better.

runners.comment: C&D winner on debut; in contention when unseating rider latest; not to be underestimated
runners.name: Lady Litigator
runners.spotlight: Made winning start over C&D (good to soft) in December, rallying after showing greenness; in contention when stumbling and unseating her rider turning for home in Listed race at Market Rasen next time; hard to know where she'd have finished in relation to winner Malina Road, but she's Anthony Honeyball's sole runner from three entries and not to be underestimated.

runners.comment: By Postponed out of the smart 2m3f-3m jumps winner Mia's Storm; interesting newcomer
runners.name: Close To Me
runners.spotlight: Home-bred by Postponed out of the smart 2m3f-3m jumps winner Mia's Storm; that's an appealing pedigree and she's one to consider, especially if the market speaks in her favour.

13:25.race_name: Virgin Bet A Good Bet Mares' Novices' Hurdle (Listed Race) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Strong form contender on her Irish exploits and 3m on good to soft could be ideal
runners.name: Barra Rua
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been at Tramore, a bumper and 2m5f maiden for mares; found Graded company too hot to handle before running well for a long way in a big-field 3m handicap at Leopardstown's big meeting this month (heavy); kept to this trip, she could appreciate these less taxing conditions.

runners.comment: Progressive for this yard and likely that she'll improve again for going over 3m
runners.name: Broomfield Aderra
runners.spotlight: Plenty of promise in Ireland and has soon raised her game for Dan Skelton, running her best race when close up under a big weight on handicap debut at Aintree two months ago (2m4f, good to soft); highly likely that she'll improve again for going over 3m.

runners.comment: Has looked a thorough stayer in winning two novices for mares at about 2m6f (heavy)
runners.name: Coolanna
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two Irish points; has looked a thorough stayer in winning two novices for mares at about 2m6f, both on heavy ground; looks a good thing to improve for 3m and any rain would be welcomed; unexposed and respected.

runners.comment: Good 4th in a Grade 2 last time; up markedly in trip but there's stamina in  her pedigree
runners.name: Dream Shadow
runners.owner: M Doocey S Doocey & P J Doocey
runners.spotlight: An improving mare who won two of her first three races over hurdles and wasn't disgraced at Warwick when raised into a Grade 2 (2m3f, heavy); unraced beyond an extended 2m4f under rules but she won a 3m point and there's stamina in her pedigree.

runners.comment: Dropped out in a Grade 2 last time and others in here have stronger form
runners.name: Easy Love
runners.spotlight: Made all in a Windsor handicap (2m4f, good) on New Year's Day to make it 2-4 over hurdles; however, dropped out in a Grade 2 last time and others in here have stronger form.

runners.comment: Has to take a step forward but that's quite feasible with her so lightly raced
runners.name: Limerick Lass
runners.spotlight: She was receiving 7lb off Livingonaprayer when they crossed the line together at Wincanton (2m5f, good to soft) and her Fontwell stroll told us nothing new, with her long odds-on that day; has to take a step forward but that's quite feasible.

runners.comment: Unbeaten this season and pedigree offers plenty of optimism for this longer trip
runners.name: Livingonaprayer
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten this season after mares' novice wins at Huntingdon (2m3f, good) and Wincanton (2m5f, good to soft), and the latter piece of form has worked out well; deserves a crack at this level and pedigree offers plenty of optimism for this longer trip; respected.

runners.comment: Wouldn't be without hope judged on her near-miss at this level at Haydock in December
runners.name: Park Princess
runners.spotlight: Wouldn't be without hope judged on her near-miss at this level at Haydock in December (2m3f, good to soft; first-time tongue-tie) and doubt she was seen to best effect when scraping home at Fontwell (2m1f); behind a couple of these at Warwick (2m3f) but heavy ground might not have suited (withdrawn previously on account of those conditions) and she also lost a shoe.

13:55.race_name: Virgin Bet Supports Safe Gambling Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Makes yard debut after two lesser runs, but he produced a notable effort in November
runners.name: Hercule Du Seuil
runners.spotlight: Ran in these colours for Willie Mullins and won five successive chases in 2023, three at Grade 3 level; has struggled the last twice (Grade 1/2) but he hardly looked gone at the game when third in the Grade 2 Fortria at Navan in November; hard to discount on first run for Neil Mullholland.

runners.comment: Pulled up latest; on a tough mark, some 18lb higher than for his win in this last year
runners.name: Brookie
runners.spotlight: Won this last year off 18lb lower and has paid the price for running respectably in Grade 1 races afterwards; ran okay to be third back in handicap company at Cheltenham but he's on a tough mark and was pulled up next time.

runners.comment: Recent 8l winner over C&D; 8lb rise could have been worse for one firmly on the upgrade
runners.name: Mighty Bandit
runners.spotlight: Flat/hurdle winner but he's looking a far superior chaser; bumped into a very smart novice on his chase debut and has since won two handicaps, the latest over C&D by some 8l (soft); an 8lb rise could have been worse for one firmly on the upgrade.

runners.comment: Impressed back at about 2m in winning a Listed chase for mares at Wincanton
runners.name: Queens Gamble
runners.spotlight: Looked hot property in bumpers and has won at Listed level in that scene and over hurdles and fences; appreciated the drop back to 1m7f (heavy; versatile ground-wise) when flooring a talented favourite on her third chase start at Wincanton where her jumping was slick throughout; the close proximity of the third horse (rated way lower) in that Listed race holds the form down, but this mare has shown she can deal with her current mark.

runners.comment: Needs a revival in the new headgear but first and second in last two runnings of this
runners.name: Homme Public
runners.spotlight: Hasn't fired in any of his races this season but connections have tweaked the headgear and he has finished first and second in the last two renewals of this race, last year when fitted in new blinkers; daren't discount.

runners.comment: The new blinkers appeared to be working until he clouted two out here a month ago
runners.name: Gabriels Getaway
runners.spotlight: None too consistent and was only fifth in this last year; however, very capable of being competitive on his best form and the first-time blinkers appeared to be working until he clouted two out here a month ago in the race won by Mighty Bandit; could run well.

14:30.race_name: Virgin Bet Grimthorpe Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Best form yet in winning at Newbury (3m2f); couldn't grumble about the 6lb rise
runners.name: Kings Threshold
runners.spotlight: Good strike-rate over fences, one he enhanced when running out a comfortable winner of the 3m2f Mandarin Chase at Newbury over Christmas (good; fine on softer); that was his best form yet and couldn't grumble about the 6lb rise; strong contender.

runners.comment: Flashes of smart form over fences and latest run on heavy can be upgraded
runners.name: Destroytheevidence
runners.spotlight: Beat Haiti Couleurs on his chase debut last season and mostly ran well afterwards; seems back in fair form, as he went close at Ludlow and ran a lot better than a 21l defeat may suggest when visored for the first time at Wincanton (3m2f); that was his first time on heavy ground and it looked a factor in him getting so tired late on; one to consider.

runners.comment: Bit below best of late; has dropped to his last winning mark and could yet come good again
runners.name: King Turgeon
runners.spotlight: Last season started well but ended badly and had a wind operation in the summer; a bit below his best, though not disgraced, in the Grand Sefton and a 3m2f handicap at Cheltenham, both races he won the previous year; has dropped to his last winning mark and could yet come good again.

runners.comment: He's 2-2 since the tongue-tie went on; 3m winner here last time; the extra 2f can help
runners.name: Dartmoor Pirate
runners.spotlight: He's 2-2 since the tongue-tie went on and, although it looked unlikely for much of the race, he stayed on much the best in the 3m Great Yorkshire Chase here a month ago (soft); he'll need to travel a bit better if he's to defy the 5lb rise but the extra 2f should help.

runners.comment: Front runs and probably needs some freedom up front if he's to be winning this
runners.name: Lord Accord
runners.spotlight: Often front runs and stays further; with first-time blinkers replacing cheekpieces he got his head back in front at Fontwell (3m2f, good to soft) and then ran as well in defeat over 3m5f at Ascot where no match for the winner; probably needs some freedom up front if he's to be winning this.

runners.breeder: S C E A Ecurie La Grugerie
runners.comment: Fell last time; potentially on a good mark should cheekpieces receive a positive response
runners.name: Jasmin De Grugy
runners.spotlight: 2-6 over fences; a beaten favourite in his last two races but perhaps needed the first of those and departed too far out at Cheltenham to know how he'd have fared; potentially on a good mark should the new cheekpieces receive a positive response.

runners.comment: He does look in the grip of the handicapper but he'll probably run well once more
runners.name: New Order
runners.spotlight: Seems to be adding some consistency to his game and has been bang there in his last three handicap chases (3m-3m1f), latterly chasing home Dartmoor Pirate here; he does look in the grip of the handicapper but he'll probably run well once more.

runners.comment: Races prominently and usually hangs around with a solid record over fences; won latest
runners.name: Kelce
runners.spotlight: Races prominently and he usually hangs around having won three times and finished runner-up on four occasions in ten starts over fences; a 7lb rise for winning a lesser race at Musselburgh (2m7f, good to soft) asks a question but he should stay okay and deserves each-way consideration.

runners.comment: Up to a career-high mark and this would be the strongest handicap he's contested
runners.name: Jubilant
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-7 over fences with a convincing enough win at Plumpton in December (3m1f, good to soft) but a 5lb rise sees him back up to a career-high mark and this would be the strongest handicap he's contested.

runners.comment: He has become hard to predict and underwent further wind surgery only recently
runners.name: Some Scope
runners.spotlight: Physical issues came to light after disappointing in a cross-country race last time; wore just a tongue-tie then but the visor that worked so well when a 3l winner here the time before now returns, as does Charlie Maggs with his claim; however, he has become hard to predict and underwent further wind surgery only recently.

runners.comment: Up in class but he's a strong stayer and has won two of his four runs over fences
runners.name: Broomfields Cave
runners.spotlight: Both chase wins have come in small fields over similar trips to this; he's a strong stayer who might have more to give after only four runs over fences, so commands respect on that alone despite this rise in class.

runners.comment: Hit and miss but he's won this race twice before so unwise to ignore him
runners.name: Moroder
runners.spotlight: Defied higher marks to win this in 2023 and again 12 months ago, and didn't arrive here in much form on either occasion; this year he returns on the back of a 12l third behind Some Scope over 3m here two months ago; had cheekpieces back on that day and now blinkers return (in which his form figures are 21P00); unwise to ignore him.

runners.comment: Won last time and well handicapped, but consistent he is not; others safer
runners.name: Theformismighty
runners.spotlight: Exploited what was a very good mark at Newcastle (2m7f, heavy) and the front two pulled clear; raised only 3lb for that but consistent he is not; others safer.

15:05.race_name: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Went off 12-1 for hurdle debut at Fontwell in October and ended up tailed off
runners.name: Asta La Vista
runners.spotlight: Not far away in a small-field Worcester bumper on debut but went off 12-1 for hurdle debut at Fontwell in October and ended up tailed off.

runners.comment: Minor form in bumpers and 100-1 when pulled up in a maiden here last month
runners.name: Berks And Bucks
runners.spotlight: Flat bred; minor form in bumpers and 100-1 when pulled up in a maiden here last month.

runners.comment: Pulled up in a Cheltenham hunter chase last May on debut under rules
runners.name: Bobbarelli
runners.spotlight: 2-12 in points so nothing special in that scene and he was pulled up in a Cheltenham hunter chase last May on debut under rules; very opposable in a race of this nature.

runners.comment: Got tired on heavy last time; his fourth at Warwick has worked out well
runners.name: Dropematthestation
runners.spotlight: Point win reads well, as does his 15l fourth in a 2m5f maiden at Warwick in December (good to soft) as that form has worked out; wouldn't read too much into his tired finish on heavy ground last time; now has tongue-tie fitted.

runners.breeder: Michel De Gigou & Haras De La Haie Neuve
runners.comment: Beaten 10l in a good race last time; can win a maiden and now goes in a tongue-tie
runners.name: Kefir dOudairies
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner; last two runs have been at Market Rasen (2m4f, good to soft), going close in November and then beaten 10l in a useful race; he's up to winning a maiden and a tongue-tie now goes on.

runners.breeder: E A R L Du Loisir
runners.comment: Second in a point; disappointed at Cheltenham in October but since had a wind operation
runners.name: Leader Crik
runners.spotlight: Bought for £160,000 soon after finishing a close second to a subsequent hurdle winner in an Irish point last May; well beaten in a Cheltenham novice hurdle (2m4f, good to soft; 10-1) in October but had wind surgery since then and no doubt capable of a lot better; the market could be instructive.

runners.comment: Disappointing at Warwick in December but had made an encouraging debut at Aintree
runners.name: Lightfingered Jack
runners.spotlight: Good jumping pedigree but it was a belated start to his career when second over 2m4f at Aintree in November and wasn't at the same level the following month at Warwick; that initial effort offers hope, as would expect him to progress with racing.

runners.comment: Responsible for some of the best form on show but he's now 0-10 over hurdles
runners.name: Tamarind Bay
runners.spotlight: Responsible for some of the best form on show but he's now 0-10 over hurdles so had his chances; probably found the ground too soft last time; might be vulnerable to rivals with lower mileage.

runners.comment: Once useful on the Flat; made an okay start over hurdles and returns to a better trip
runners.name: Whos Glen
runners.spotlight: Became disappointing on the Flat after finishing fifth in the 2025 Chester Cup; has shown an aptitude for jumping and this trip looks a better fit than the 2m1f he ran over last time.

runners.comment: Handicap debut; market support would be welcomed on first start since September
runners.name: Tilehurst
runners.spotlight: Won small-field bumper for Henry Daly; placed in three maiden hurdles last year and doesn't look on too bad a mark if judged on the first two; market support would be welcomed on first start since September.

runners.comment: Raised 12lb for successive wins but he has the momentum behind him
runners.name: The Resdev Tyke
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism in his last two handicaps on soft and good to soft; it was harder work after a 6lb hit last time and now has to defy the same rise, but he has momentum behind him.

runners.comment: Returning from a long absence when second on handicap debut at Hereford
runners.name: Chevington
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo who was returning from a long absence when second on handicap debut at Hereford just before Christmas (2m, soft); had another break since then and he's 2lb higher, but can no doubt improve again.

runners.comment: It's been a solid start in handicaps and held his own in a higher grade last time
runners.name: Captain Cool
runners.spotlight: It's been a solid start in handicaps and held his own in a higher grade four weeks ago at Musselburgh (good to soft); the tongue-tie is retained and the cheekpieces tried last time are removed; that's no obvious negative and he can run well.

runners.comment: Beaten a neck on his handicap debut last April but four lesser runs have followed
runners.name: Caramelo Rapido
runners.spotlight: Beaten a neck on his handicap debut last April (2m1f, good) but four lesser runs have followed, so has to turn things around.

runners.comment: After his fourth to The Resdev Tyke on Boxing Day he ran no race at Sedgefield
runners.name: Animato
runners.spotlight: Had plenty of Flat racing and won five times; 0-6 as a hurdler and after his fourth to The Resdev Tyke on Boxing Day he ran no race at Sedgefield; others preferred.

runners.comment: Best form has been over fences (in defeat); tailed off back over hurdles last time
runners.name: Prized Jet
runners.spotlight: A long way clear when falling at the fourth-last fence at Sedgefield (2m5f, good) in October and ran well to a point back there on his stable debut; she never got that competitive back over hurdles this month.

runners.comment: In a respected yard but has no show in either of his handicaps, at 2m and 3m
runners.name: New Invention
runners.spotlight: In a respected yard but has offered little in either of his handicaps, at 2m and 3m (latterly with cheekpieces added); hard to make a case.

runners.comment: Ran okay in his first handicap; pulled up next time but has since had a wind operation
runners.name: Romancier
runners.spotlight: Showed more when beaten about 7l on handicap debut in December (soft) but then disappointed at Catterick; has had wind surgery since and now goes in cheekpieces, so may rebound.

runners.comment: Poor so far but handicap newcomers from this yard always need checking in the betting
runners.name: Yummy
runners.spotlight: Thoroughly tailed off so far over hurdles but handicap newcomers from this yard always need checking in the betting.

runners.comment: Ran well on most starts last March-June; not so good in October on latest outing
runners.name: Minella Rescue
runners.spotlight: Ran well over this sort of trip on most starts last March-June; not so good in October on latest outing and needs to resume improvement.

runners.comment: Big odds in Grade 2s last two starts; second off the same mark in this race last term
runners.name: Kamsinas
runners.spotlight: Second in two small-field chases this season before reverting to hurdles at big odds for two Cheltenham Grade 2s, soundly beaten on latest occasion; runner-up off the same mark in this race last term; 5lb claimer takes over and they are considered each-way.

runners.comment: He hasn't built significantly on novice wins; shaped as if staying 3m on penultimate start
runners.name: Intosomethinggood
runners.spotlight: Pulled up at 40-1 in a Grade 2 novice over C&D on latest outing; he hasn't built significantly on his three novice wins last summer but he did shape as if he stayed 3m on penultimate start.

runners.comment: 3m Wincanton 2nd; ran creditably in the Lanzarote, before modest show at Plumpton latest
runners.name: Ike Sport
runners.spotlight: His last win was in April 2024; looked stretched by the trip in this race last year, albeit after making much of the running, which isn't his usual style; second at Wincanton (3m, good to soft) at Christmas was his best show this term but he ran creditably in the Lanzarote next time, before a modest show at Plumpton latest; others look a bit more solid.

runners.comment: Maiden win (extended 2m3f, heavy) makes him a striking candidate for 3m on handicap debut
runners.name: Big Ticket
runners.spotlight: Maiden point winner last May; second at Aintree and Ascot on his first two runs over hurdles; pulled up with an overreach next time but asserted in eventually good style when he justified 11-8 favouritism in a maiden at Lingfield (extended 2m3f, heavy) this month, which makes him a striking candidate for 3m on this handicap debut.

runners.comment: Won three (2m7f, 2m6f and 2m3f) of his seven handicaps, including here penultimate start
runners.name: Serious Chat
runners.spotlight: Has won three (2m7f, 2m6f and 2m3f) of his seven handicaps, including here on penultimate start; he didn't fire in quite the same way at Musselburgh on latest and needs a career best.

runners.comment: Doncaster form figures 1P2114, last five of which were in chases; 10lb lower hurdles mark
runners.name: Docpickedme
runners.spotlight: Doncaster form figures read 1P2114, the last five of which were over fences; not disgraced last time and this hurdles mark is 10lb lower, so a case can be made.

runners.comment: Career-best form in third over about 3m under Cameron Johnstone-Baker on last two outings
runners.name: Porter In The Park
runners.spotlight: Third on all four starts in October-December this term, showing career-best form over about 3m under Cameron Johnstone-Baker on last two occasions; absent two months but not far away if all is well.

16:50.race_name: Virgin Bet 'Junior' National Hunt Flat Race (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: Pitchall Stud Partnership & Mrs Pat Toye
runners.comment: Placed at Huntingdon and Wetherby but probably has to step up on those efforts
runners.name: Cotton Socks
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on debut in Huntingdon bumper (2m, good to soft) in November and similar form when third of eight at Wetherby in December (2m, soft; carried head awkwardly); probably has to step up on those efforts.

runners.comment: Tenth foal from a prolific family and would be of interest should the market bode well
runners.name: Friendly Glance
runners.spotlight: Tenth foal from a prolific family and would be of strong interest should the market bode well.

runners.comment: Well in rear but came through to finish fourth of 16 in a Listed bumper at Cheltenham
runners.name: Ivor Bear
runners.spotlight: Out of a 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase winner; well in rear but came through to finish fourth of 16 in a Listed bumper at Cheltenham on New Year's Day (good; 18-1); that run sets the standard.

runners.comment: Difficult to know what he achieved when fifth on the AW at Lingfield as only six ran
runners.name: Moscow Star
runners.spotlight: Difficult to know what he achieved when fifth on the AW at Lingfield as he wasn't beaten far but only six ran; this should reveal more.

runners.comment: Trainer respected in bumpers; won one recently with a well-backed newcomer
runners.name: Music Song
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to 11.5f/1m4f AQPS Flat and 2m1f/2m2f chase winner Lavriot Star; dam placed 11.7f AQPS Flat, half-sister to winners Georges Saint (2m3f-2m5f chase) and Kobalt St Georges (2m1f-2m5f hurdle); trainer has become a respected figure in bumpers and he won one recently with a well-backed newcomer.

runners.comment: Withdrawn (due to a temperature) from last week's 1m4f AW novice won by Constitution Hill
runners.name: Noble Way
runners.spotlight: Flat bred and cost 12,000euros at two; second foal out of a French maiden (best run at 10.5f; RPR 69) and half-sister to French 6.5f 2yo winner Al Motasim; withdrawn (due to a temperature) from last week's 1m4f AW novice won by Constitution Hill; rare bumper runner for this yard.

runners.comment: Beaten 14l and 18l in his first two bumpers and headgear is soon turned to
runners.name: Winstons Oath
runners.spotlight: Made 310,000gns as a yearling but 8,500gns last September as a 3yo; beaten 14l and 18l in his first two bumpers and headgear is soon turned to.

runners.comment: First foal; dam 2m Flat winner (RPR 69), half-sister to useful 6f winner Greeb
runners.name: Zotay Nzuri
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam 2m Flat winner (RPR 69), half-sister to useful 6f winner Greeb, out of unraced sister to 2,000 Guineas/Champion Stakes winner Haafhd; yard only 3-49 in bumpers recent seasons but makes sense to check the betting.

runners.comment: 125-1 and completely tailed off on good to soft at Kempton this month
runners.name: Ebony Ebbs
runners.spotlight: 125-1 and completely tailed off on good to soft at Kempton this month.

13:00.race_name: Create Your Bet Builders At Midnite Handicap

runners.comment: Cosy winner at Southwell last week and another bold bid is on the cards
runners.name: Wonder
runners.spotlight: Had a bit so spare when seeing off ten rivals in a 1m4f Southwell handicap last week; has a bit of class for this level and he's likely to make another bold bid.

runners.comment: C&D win in January and got up late over 1m5f here last weekend; should go well again
runners.name: Charlies Choice
runners.spotlight: C&D win in January and landed another course success when getting up in the final strides over 1m5f last Saturday, both under Taryn Langley; a 2lb nudge shouldn't prevent another prominent showing.

runners.comment: Edged out Wonder over C&D last month and extended his run of good form when second since
runners.name: Damascus Steel
runners.spotlight: Made it two wins in a row when edging out Wonder over C&D last month; extended his run of good form when second of ten at Wolverhampton (1m4f) four weeks ago; should figure again.

runners.comment: Largely struggled of late, including for this yard last twice
runners.name: Kingkeer
runners.spotlight: Won a Windsor handicap (11.5f) last May, but he's generally struggled since, including never involved in two 1m course handicaps in recent weeks; this trip is more suitable but would need to see market support to consider.

runners.breeder: Exors Of The Late Mrs L Peacock
runners.comment: Close second at Wolverhampton latest but no win since summer 2024
runners.name: One Cool Dreamer
runners.spotlight: Back on form when collared only near the line over 1m6f at Wolverhampton 25 days ago; nudged back up 2lb, though, and remains winless since summer 2024.

runners.comment: Well handicapped but not obviously threatening to take advantage
runners.name: Pleasant Man
runners.spotlight: Hasn't really been threatening to take advantage of his reduced mark, finishing sixth of 11 to Wonder over 1m4f at Southwell eight days ago; others are preferred again.

runners.comment: Multiple C&D winner; thereabouts this winter and should figure in first-time cheekpieces
runners.name: Party Island
