runners.spotlight: Four-time C&D winner who was also runner-up twice over C&D towards the end of 2025; made good ground to briefly hit the front entering the final furlong when fourth of 13 over 1m3f at Kempton last time; gets belated first-time cheekpieces on the back of that; likely to be on the premises.

runners.comment: Has beaten only one home in last three starts so new cheekpieces need to help
runners.name: Tatmeen
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at Kempton (1m4f) last May but his more recent form is far less encouraging, beating only one home in his last three starts; has first-time cheekpieces added to his regular hood.

13:30.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Handicap

runners.comment: Clearcut winner of Wolverhampton maiden; makes handicap debut here; unexposed
runners.name: Arishkas Dream
runners.spotlight: Came good at fifth attempt in maiden at Wolverhampton (6f; 4-1) 12 days ago, in front before halfway and clear over 1f out; open to further progress and should be in the shake-up again on today's handicap debut.

runners.comment: Form of Wolverhampton second has been boosted; interesting on handicap debut
runners.name: Escape Plan
runners.spotlight: Steady improvement in three runs last season; second in 6f novice at Wolverhampton when last seen in September, and winner Ten Carat Harry (runs 2.35 on this card) has gone in five times since; makes handicap debut in a first-time tongue-strap, having been gelded; interesting contender.

runners.comment: Just modest form in three runs last term but has had wind surgery and may yet do better
runners.name: Yes Waliim
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to a useful sprinter for his connections; just modest form in three outings last term, not finishing his races with much purpose; hardly looks thrown in for handicap debut but he's had wind surgery and may yet do better.

runners.comment: Off the mark on final run for William Haggas, but well held on stable debut last time
runners.name: Henriette Ronner
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark (6f; first-time blinkers) on the last of her six starts for William Haggas, but she was well held off her revised mark on stable debut 17 days ago and will need a major bounce back to be in with a chance here.

runners.comment: Didn't run much of a race here last month but may revive after short break
runners.name: Cool Molly
runners.spotlight: Didn't run much of a race on handicap debut here last month, but she'd been reliable over 5f and 6f before then, winning a Chelmsford maiden in January; may revive after a short break.

runners.comment: Hard to steer from a wide draw here two weeks ago but he'd previously bolted up over C&D
runners.name: Far Too Fizzy
runners.spotlight: Lived up to his name and proved hard to steer from a wide draw here two weeks ago, but he'd previously bolted up over C&D with Mister Moet well held in second and Henriette Ronner last; 8lb higher today but he'll be dangerous if racing more amenably than last time.

runners.comment: 1-13; finished fast here two weeks ago and likely to be thereabouts once more
runners.name: Corniche Girl
runners.owner: C Munro Mrs M Gander And Partner
runners.spotlight: Effective at 5f to 1m; sole win from 13 attempts came at Kempton last summer, but she's knocking at the door again and finished fast from off the pace here last time; sometimes looks a tricky ride (can be slowly away) but she's likely to be thereabouts once more.

runners.comment: 50-1 and hooded when fourth here last week; others may have more potential
runners.name: Denbys Dream
runners.spotlight: Wasn't beaten far by Mister Moet when 50-1 and hooded for the first time over C&D last week; may give her running again but others probably have more potential.

runners.comment: Easy winner on stable debut; well held next time but this return to sprinting should help
runners.name: Luna Beaux
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all eight outings in Ireland last year; made an immediate impact for new yard when waltzing clear of eight rivals over 6f at Wolverhampton in January, but failed to repeat the form over 7f there last time; now 12lb higher than for the win but this return to sprinting should help.

runners.comment: Narrow C&D winner last week; up in grade and will have to raise his game to follow up
runners.name: Mister Moet
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come at 6f, latest on this course last week (led near finish); only 2lb higher but up in grade and will have to raise his game to follow up.

14:05.race_name: Bet £10 Get £40 With BetMGM Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.comment: His placed efforts over 7f (including here) last year set a decent standard
runners.name: Captain Fox
runners.spotlight: Stepped up on debut when second over 7f here last September and advanced his RPR again when third in 7f Newmarket maiden later that month; those efforts set the standard here; has been gelded ahead of reappearance.

runners.comment: Ran to only a modest level when 5l second on debut but should improve
runners.name: Kokushoku
runners.spotlight: Sent off at 8-15 but ran to only a modest level when 5l second of four on 7f Wolverhampton debut last month; likely to improve for that experience but he will need to take a fairly big step forward if Captain Fox reproduces last year's form.

runners.comment: Promising second on 1m Newcastle debut last month; should progress
runners.name: Sovereign Bay
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to smart 7f winner Serengeti and made an encouraging start to his career when second of ten in 1m Newcastle maiden 24 days ago; the fourth in that race won at Wolverhampton earlier in the week; should progress.

runners.comment: Cost 320,000gns as a yearling but no obvious promise in two turf runs last year; hood on
runners.name: Lady Vanguard
runners.spotlight: This daughter of Lope De Vega cost 320,000gns as a yearling but didn't show much obvious promise in two turf outings at the end of last summer; has a hood added for her reappearance.

runners.comment: Likely best watched on debut.
runners.name: The Bureau Club
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to two winners in the French Caribbean; fitted with a hood on debut; likely best watched.

runners.comment: Running creditably in defeat in Dubai this year; steps up in trip with each-way claims
runners.name: Hilitany
runners.spotlight: Two 6f wins at Windsor last summer before finishing seventh in the Group 1 Middle Park; unplaced but ran creditably in three sprint runs in Dubai this year; steps up to 7f with each-way claims.

runners.comment: Promising Newmarket debut before bolting up over C&D in November; looks a good prospect
runners.name: Richies Rocket
runners.spotlight: 22-1 for his Newmarket debut (7f, good) last October, running green in the closing stages but finishing a promising third (race working out well); still looked a bit babyish when routing his rivals over C&D three weeks later (good Topspeed figure); in deeper today but he is promising.

runners.comment: Ready 6f win at Newcastle when last seen; more to come at 7f; in deep on stable debut
runners.name: Shahik
runners.spotlight: Improved race by race as a 2yo for George Boughey, winning a 6f maiden at Newcastle in good style when last seen in October; only four ran there and the form is well short of a few of his rivals but he is open to further progress at this trip; sold for 55,000gns since latest run.

runners.comment: Progressed quickly last summer; quiet on final 2yo outing but still a key player on return
runners.name: Sir Albert
runners.spotlight: Progressive 2yo last summer, winning a novice at Newcastle (6f) before adding 7f nursery wins at Chester (good) and Goodwood (heavy); took another step forward when a close third in Listed company at Doncaster's St Leger meeting but he failed to fire at Ascot on Champions Day; has the highest BHA rating in the field and returns with his stable in good form.

runners.comment: 6-6 on AW; latest Newcastle success was a big personal best; 7f a slight query but feared
runners.name: Ten Carat Harry
runners.spotlight: Boasts a perfect 6-6 record on AW surfaces, including here, and he took his form to a new level when readily seeing off ten rivals in a useful handicap at Newcastle six weeks ago; only third in his one crack at this trip but it was slow turf and he is a better horse now; takes on some promising rivals but hard to crab a horse who keeps on winning.

runners.comment: Useful form over 6f/7f as a 2yo; unexposed at the trip & could progress further; AW debut
runners.name: Bella Lyra
runners.spotlight: Impressed in a 6f fillies' novice at Windsor last June before acquitting herself with credit in Listed/Group 3 company; ended her 2yo campaign with a second-place finish in a valuable sales race in Germany (7f, soft); could progress further this year; interesting on AW debut.

runners.breeder: Mrs Liz Barry & Mr Luke Barry
runners.comment: Stayed on well to beat a stablemate in a 6f Southwell novice last month; this is tougher
runners.name: Starfinch
runners.owner: Mrs Frank Barry & Mrs Luke Barry
runners.spotlight: Low-key stable debut at the Curragh last August when trained by Jessica Harrington; left that effort well behind her when staying on strongly to beat her better-fancied stablemate in a 6f fillies' novice at Southwell last month; open to improvement but it will be needed.

runners.comment: Impressed at Dundalk (7f) on stable debut; big step up in class but unexposed
runners.name: Star Strewn
runners.spotlight: Promise in two Dundalk runs for Cormac Farrell and she made an impressive winning debut for this yard at Dundalk 17 days ago (7f); pitched in deeper today but she could well have more in the tank.

15:10.race_name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Handicap (Div I)

runners.comment: Showed promise in two runs in the autumn and he's open to progress upped to 1m3f on return
runners.name: High Storm
runners.spotlight: 85,000gns yearling by Nathaniel; prominent in the market and he showed promise when beaten 4l in two small-field events on turf (7f/8.3f, good to soft) in the autumn; recorded an RPR of 72 in both those runs but it's still early days and he's open to progress upped to 1m3f on his return; been gelded.

runners.comment: Cost 155,000gns as yearling but he struggled on debut in October and has been gelded since
runners.name: La Peregrina
runners.spotlight: 150,000gns yearling; out of a half-sister to a 2yo Group 3 winner (1m2f), but he was tailed off at 33-1 on Redcar debut (1m1f, good to soft) in October; been gelded since and is best watched on his reappearance.

runners.comment: Brother to a Group 2 winner and he's an interesting newcomer; yard also runs Sailor Song
runners.name: Pursuit Of Love
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; brother to 1m2f-1m4f winner Fanny Logan (including Group 2; RPR 116), half-brother to winners Tangled Words (7f AW 2yo; 74) and Uncle Matthew (1m3f AW; 69); dam Listed-placed 9.5f-1m4f winner (including AW; 101), half-sister to 1m1f/1m2f Group 1 winner; lots to like on paper and he's an interesting newcomer.

runners.comment: 100,000euros yearling; already been gelded but he needs a close look in market on debut
runners.name: Sailor Song
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros yearling; first foal; dam 1m/1m2f winner (RPR 101), half-sister to Group 1 winners Eldar Eldarov (St Leger) and Kingswood (NZ 1m2f), out of French 1m2f/10.5f Listed winner; already been gelded but yard was 43% in novice events last year and he needs a close look on debut; stablemate of Pursuit Of Love.

runners.comment: Promising second on Kempton debut last month and she sets a fair standard on that form
runners.name: Distorted Truth
runners.spotlight: Sister to 1m/1m2f winner Westernesse (including AW; RPR 95); well backed into 100-30 on Kempton debut (1m3f) last month and she kept on well to finish runner-up behind an experienced rival; that was a promising start and she sets a fair standard on that form.

runners.comment: Shaped with promise on 1m debut here last month and she's open to progress upped in trip
runners.name: You Got To My Soul
runners.spotlight: 175,000gns half-sister to seven winners including Gipoia (1m2f including Listed; RPR 103) and Falcao Negro (8.5f-1m4f including AW/Listed; 102); never dangerous when third of seven on debut here (1m) last month but she should know more this time and is a likely improver upped in trip.

20:00.race_name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap

runners.comment: Newcastle specialist but hasn't been at best there in last three runs; needs to step up
runners.name: Prince Achille
runners.spotlight: His last five wins have come at Newcastle, but he hasn't been at his best there in last three starts; went close off this mark in November but he needs to get back near that level; all AW wins have been at 1m2f but he has won over this trip on turf.

runners.comment: Not easy to predict but he won at Chelmsford last month and was runner-up over C&D latest
runners.name: Seraphic
runners.spotlight: Strong traveller who is not easy to predict but he won at Chelmsford (1m2f) last month and was runner-up over C&D three weeks ago; on same mark as last time and he's a big player if he can back that up.

runners.breeder: Ashtown B/S O B Sarl E Puerari G Bozo
runners.comment: Back on Flat with fair fourth at Wolverhampton (1m6f) but he needs to build on that
runners.name: Chicago Storm
runners.spotlight: Won twice over hurdles early last year but he was tailed off in that sphere in his final run in 2025; returned to the Flat with fair fourth at Wolverhampton (1m6f) last month but was never dangerous in that race and he needs to build on that back in trip.

runners.comment: 0-8 and he's been well held in both runs for current yard; tongue-tie added
runners.name: Karthala
runners.spotlight: 0-6 for Roger Varian and he's been well held in both runs for new yard this year, including over C&D; continues to drop down the weights but he needs the first-time tongue-tie to make a difference.

runners.comment: Dual Tapeta winner but he's been well held in last three runs and others are preferred
runners.name: Educate
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been on Tapeta and latest was at Wolverhampton (1m4f) last April; runner-up three times in the autumn but he bled from the nose in final run last year and has been well held again in both starts for current yard; probably did too much too soon at Wolverhampton last time but others are more persuasive.

runners.breeder: Exors Of The Late Mrs B E Moore
runners.comment: Nine-race maiden and he needs a major revival in new headgear
runners.name: Arths Gold
runners.spotlight: Close third in a C&D handicap in December but he's not matched that form in three runs since and was beaten 10l at Chelmsford last week; record is now 0-9 and he needs a major revival in new headgear.

runners.comment: Two wins at Southwell this winter and has possibilities if she can rediscover her spark
runners.name: Hackney Diamonds
runners.spotlight: Hasn't really fired on Tapeta in last two runs but she's won twice at Southwell this winter including over C&D; should get a decent tow into this race and has possibilities if she can rediscover her spark.

runners.comment: Nine-race maiden and has plenty to prove after 400 days off; tongue-tie on
runners.name: Nala The Lioness
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden who struggled here (1m3f/1m6f) in her final two runs for Karl Burke last winter; changed hands for 10,000gns since; tongue-tie is now tried on stable debut but has plenty to prove after 400 days off.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo who was a promising third at Wolverhampton (1m4f) last time; shortlisted
runners.name: The Corporate Guy
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who ran his best race so far when third of 12 in a Wolverhampton handicap (1m4f, Tapeta) 26 days ago; that was a promising effort after a slow start and he's respected off only 1lb higher here.

runners.comment: Unexposed 4yo who won on handicap debut over C&D last month; respected up 5lb
runners.name: Velvet Red
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 4yo who returned from a break with a 25-1 win on handicap debut over C&D last month; up 5lb but that was a convincing success and she's open to more progress over middle distances; respected.

runners.comment: Won here last March but he's been generally disappointing since; no headgear for new yard
runners.name: Spec Of Light
runners.spotlight: Won here (1m) last March but he's been generally disappointing since and was never involved after a slow start at Wolverhampton (9.4f) 26 days ago; left David Loughnane since then and has something to prove for new yard; headgear removed.

runners.breeder: The Rumble Racing Club - White Chocolate
runners.comment: Improver who completed a hat-trick at Newcastle (1m4f) two weeks ago; big player again
runners.name: Havachoc
runners.spotlight: Improver who made it 3-8 on AW when completing a hat-trick in good style at Newcastle (1m4f) two weeks ago; up another 4lb but he's on a roll and could continue on the upgrade; key player.

runners.comment: Peak effort could be misleading and down the field on last month's stable/handicap debut
runners.name: Call Margot
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in three 2yo runs for Diego Dias; down the field on last month's stable/handicap debut (C&D) and needs to prove she isn't flattered by this mark (earned after finishing last of six in a Listed race on debut).

runners.comment: C&D winner last September; 5th behind Love Alive on seasonal return; may be sharper today
runners.name: Rotokura Belle
runners.owner: Crazy Racing Ltd & Miss D Francis
runners.spotlight: Cosy C&D winner last September off a 5lb lower mark; fifth to Love Alive at Wolverhampton on her reappearance this month and could be sharper with that behind her; betting useful.

runners.comment: Finished off strongly to win at Wolverhampton 25 days ago; 1lb rise may prove lenient
runners.name: Love Alive
runners.spotlight: Finished off strongly to win a 5f handicap at Wolverhampton 25 days ago, her second run for the yard; that form has a solid look to it and a 1lb rise may prove lenient; still relatively unexposed.

runners.comment: Ended 2025 with two solid AW runs but returns off a 2lb higher mark and needs more to win
runners.name: Liverpool Star
runners.spotlight: 0-7 but he ended 2025 with two solid efforts on AW; returns off a 2lb higher mark though and a career best will be required.

runners.comment: Bath nursery win last September but this winter's two AW runs need bettering
runners.name: Reality Queen
runners.spotlight: Chance if returning to the level she showed when winning at Bath last September but her two runs this winter need bettering.

runners.comment: No progress for handicapping after a wind op; now drops to 5f for the first time
runners.name: Alfa Duplicate
runners.spotlight: No improvement for the switch to handicaps (after a wind op) this year, down the field over 6f and 7f at Wolverhampton; now drops to 5f for the first time; stable also run Rotokura Belle.

runners.comment: Well backed when winning in determined fashion at Newcastle last month; unexposed on AW
runners.name: Contorno
runners.spotlight: Well supported ahead of his seasonal/AW debut at Newcastle last month and duly took a good step forward, keeping on well to see off six rivals; the form has been bolstered since and there could be more to come; this is a stronger race though.
